entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • System.Numerics Vector2/3/4 static methods possibly have incorrect return type, and lack documentation #121689
  • Incorrect ildasm output due to invalid printf format string. #121686
  • [Bounds checks] Conditional Slice pattern #121682
    11.0.0
  • `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` when creating FrozenDictionary with very large strings #121673

Closed

  • First class span's break EFC #109757
  • .NET10 Disabling Hardware Intrinsics not working #121685
  • Add EventSource guid ctors for non-reflection creation #28290
    11.0.0
  • ArrBnds assertion with Phi index doesn't remove bounds checks. #121617
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix ildasm output on Linux by replacing I64 format specifiers with PRIx64 #121687
  • Remove dead code: compVSQuirkStackPaddingNeeded field #121684
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Use SSA-based GetRange for ArrLen in OptimizeRangeCheck #121683
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Remove unsafe code from Uri path dot & slash unescaping #121680
    area-System.Net, reduce-unsafe, 11.0.0
  • Insert a set of known types and methods references necessary for async thunks into the mutable module #121679
    area-crossgen2-coreclr
  • Fix overflow in LengthBuckets for large strings #121674
    area-System.Collections, community-contribution

Merged

  • Remove unused references to SafeHandle methods in corelib.h #121681
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • Introduce a new internal EventSourceGenerator and use it for all ES implementations #121180
    area-System.Diagnostics.Tracing
  • Remove bounds checks for Phi indices #121640
    area-CodeGen-coreclr

Updated

  • Remove unsafe code from Uri PrivateParseMinimal, CheckAuthorityHelper, and related helpers #121671
    area-System.Net, reduce-unsafe, 11.0.0
  • JIT: Support async contexts for OSR/EnC #121672
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 679: Build ID 2840365 #121062
    area-Infrastructure-libraries
  • Remove unsafe code from Guid.TryFormat #121652
    area-System.Runtime, reduce-unsafe
  • Rename AsyncMethodKind enum values: NotAsync→Ordinary, RuntimeAsync→TaskReturningILAsync #121649
    area-VM-coreclr, runtime-async
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #121614
    area-codeflow
